text_block_list.text: Cheers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Can you hear it? The thunderous
adulation, all for
me?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Cheers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If you hear it, know that it's a mere
hallucination.
For in reality...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It is the sound of praise that will ring out
in my
future.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, raise the curtain on this
magnificent opera.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Yes, for this is...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Unfathomable beauty and unrivaled

strength—the origin story of the
Centurial
Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It's happened. Т.М. Опера О is in the
Twinkle
Series at last.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I should tell her now, though.
Umamusume are
normally training at the
track around this time.
However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hark! This beauty that is in me, that is in
the
reflection of this mirror, that is on
the floor upon
which I stand...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I fear the mirror might crack from the
stress of
containing so much magnetism.
But crack it
should!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: ...Why does it not crack?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Opera O, do you have a minute?

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, if it isn't my one and only
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What brings you at this hour? Was the
desire to
look upon me so strong that
you raced here with
all speed?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: ...Wh-wh-WHAAAT?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What did you just say? I didn't quite
catch it, but
I could swear you said...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That I am to take part in the Twinkle
Series... Was
it something along those
lines?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ah, I see, yes. So the time has come.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The great suffering that Umamusume
fans had to
endure comes to mind. You
might ask why...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: It is because they have never been able to witness my immense beauty, my immense talent, my immense nobility racing across the track.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A life without my presence is not worth
living. It is
no different than to be
imprisoned in the deepest
depths of the
underworld.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A true age of darkness! But that
melancholy has
come to an end!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: The masses must know the Overlord, so the light of happiness can shine upon them.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
With my entry decided, things cannot
remain like
this. Now, Trainer, we must
train!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: We've come to the track to begin, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahem. First, to rehearse my victory
performance.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
To do so... a quick scamper across the
green turf
should suffice!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Huff... Whew... I have not the time to be winded. The masses await my wondrous words!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hello, one and all! Did you have an
invigorating
view of my beautiful stride?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am the one and only T.M. Opera
O—the
stunning and powerful Overlord.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Soon to become the Centurial
Overlord—the
Umamusume who will
conquer this world!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What? The turn of the century has long
since
passed, you say? Heh...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Fear not. In the face of my gorgeous
visage, this
twilight will end, and the
next turn will commence
before you
even know it.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This is what training means to T.M.
Opera O.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While parading around calling herself
the
Overlord, some of her antics prove

productive—others not so much...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite her constant pausing to display
these
over-the-top performances, the
way she
proclaims her lordliness shows a
lot of potential.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The intensity of her assertions coincide
with her
ability.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The prelude has concluded. My
preparations are
complete.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I shall make dreams come true with my

jaw-dropping victory and stake my claim
as the
Centurial Overlord.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My radiant beauty shall become the sun
that
illuminates the ignorant
masses—and the world!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, let us take the first step down our
victory
road, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Guide me to the summit of the Twinkle
Series!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She asks me to lead, despite her being
the one
boldly speeding ahead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Celebrate, peoples of the
world! For
my journey begins now!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She yells at the top of her lungs from the
rooftop.
The other Umamusume at the
academy stare up
at us, dumbfounded.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
